comments.author: peterbailey-arista
comments.body:
@vmittal-msft thank you for review, I've updated my PR:

**Multi-ASIC namespace mismatch in _history_config_is (likely blocker on multi-ASIC)**
Yes this is expected, hence why I indicate https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/27047 is required to merge first right in my PR's comment. I tested this on our 7280dr3a broadcom multi-asic fixed boxes. No change to PR.

**Feature/version gating is too coarse**
I have updated the PR with an additional skip to ensure this is being run on sonic version that have the pfc stat history feature (202511 or higher).

**Accuracy-test tolerance may be flaky**
My own testing has not revealed this to be problematic, but I have loosened the time to add 200ms for any extra cli jitter as asked

**Minor: _to_int masks bad data**
Understood, but the purpose of a custom _to_int is that I'm using it against the CLI and the purpose is to pull empty or NA which means no data collected and we can only assume 0 transitions until data is populated. No change to PR.
